test_title: PYST 12: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the correct summary of the given passage.

options.text: The organisations prepared GHI with unquestionable criteria taken all the things into consideration.
Primarily based on the children’s height and weight, the nation’s GHI 2022 was calculated, so India’s place was 107 which is questionable.
Child growth is important though india is trying hard to combat the problem. When it is addressed, India will not be a hunger country
The GHI report is good with perfect language, but the pictures are not beautiful and colourful.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the questionable nature of the **Global Hunger Index (GHI)** rankings, particularly how they are primarily based on children's height and weight, which might not accurately reflect the national hunger situation.
 
• **Option 2 **accurately captures the essence by stating the primary basis for the **nation’s GHI 2022 calculation **and the resulting rank for India.
 
• Options 1, 3, and 4 do not accurately summarize the passage:
 
 
• **Option 1:** **"The organisations prepared GHI with unquestionable criteria taken all the things into consideration."** - This is incorrect as the passage questions the criteria used.
 
• **Option 3:** **"Child growth is important though India is trying hard to combat the problem. When it is addressed, India will not be a hunger country."** - This is a positive spin not directly mentioned or emphasized in the passage.
 
• **Option 4:** **"The GHI report is good with perfect language, but the pictures are not beautiful and colourful." **- This is a misinterpretation of the passage, as it states the pictures are beautiful.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

**Correct Summary:** Primarily based on the children’s height and weight, the nation’s** GHI **2022 was calculated, so India’s place was 107 which is questionable.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option Analysis:** 

 
 
• **Option 1:** The passage explicitly questions the criteria used by the GHI, making this option inaccurate.
 
• **Option 3:** While child growth is mentioned, the passage does not discuss India’s efforts to combat the problem in detail.
 
• **Option 4:** The passage speaks highly of the report's formatting and pictures, making this option incorrect.
